headline: News Corp Provides Update on Ongoing $1 Billion Share Buyback
summary: News Corp provided an update regarding the execution of its ongoing $1 billion stock repurchase program.
why: Share buyback programs reduce outstanding share counts and signal management confidence in capital allocation and shareholder returns.

impacts.name: News Corp
impacts.why: Ongoing execution of a major stock repurchase program returns capital to shareholders and supports share price.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
